snippet.title: Velana Adventures: Ch 1 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Here is our first look and announcement trailer for Velana Adventures: Chapter 1. This is the first of a series of small side stories in the Velana world. 

Wishlist it here: https://bit.ly/va1-steam
